hookups.source: https://www.travelerswoods.com/reserve ('Most of our RV sites are 30 Amp, but we do have a few 50 Amp sites.', 'We have 8 full hook-up sites. The remainder are water & electric sites.'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.travelerswoods.com/reserve ('Free Wi-Fi', 'Laundry Facilities', 'Clean Restrooms with Free Showers', 'Camp Store', 'We offer pump out service ($) and have 2 dump stations'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Level, grassy RV sites (8 full hookup, the rest water/electric) and tent sites, plus a rally field for groups of up to 40 units. The operator says 'We can accommodate large rigs' without a length.

sites.source: https://www.travelerswoods.com/ ('Our 125 sites are available for daily, weekly and longer-term stays', 'For groups of up to 40 camping units, we offer a rally field') + https://www.travelerswoods.com/reserve, read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.travelerswoods.com/reserve ('Information for our Season APRIL 30—October 15') + https://www.travelerswoods.com/ ('WE ARE CLOSED FOR THE 2026 CAMPING SEASON. WE WILL REOPEN APRIL 30th 2027'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations by the request form on the operator's reserve page (answered by email) or by phone, 413-648-9105; no instant online booking. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Columbus Day) need 3 nights.

booking.source: https://www.travelerswoods.com/reserve ('RESERVATIONS CAN BE MADE BY EITHER CLICKING ON THE "GREEN AVAILABILITY AND RESERVATIONS" BANNER BELOW AND FILLING OUT THE FORM, OR YOU MAY PHONE US AT 413-648-9105', 'Holidays (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day, and Columbus Day) have a 3-night minimum'), read 2026-10-28

note: Private family-run campground (42 years) on River Street in Bernardston, in the Connecticut River Valley, with a rally field and covered pavilion for groups and river fishing on site. Rigs over 10.5 ft tall should use the operator's directions, not GPS, to avoid a low-clearance bridge. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on travelerswoods.com: RV water/electric $40, full hookup $45 (2 adults; fees left as recorded, unchanged), 125 sites, 30/50 amp (mostly 30), 8 full-hookup sites, 2 dump stations, free showers, laundry, store, free wifi, phone 413-648-9105, holiday 3-night minimum (now in booking.min_stay). Changed season (derived) -> Apr 30-Oct 15 (operator; 2026 season over, reopens Apr 30 2027). Booking: request form or phone (platform operator). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront; not changed): the operator lists 'River Fishing' among its amenities, and on imagery the outer campground loop runs within ~50 m of the Fall River along the property's NE edge behind a tree line. Needs a look at which sites (if any) sit on the bank.
Price gate: passes - base $40 (RV water/electric, up to 2 adults) under US$50; additional adults $10/night, EV charging $10/night extra. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Hartford 100 km).

Long-stay tests: passes - nightly rates posted and 125 sites 'available for daily, weekly and longer-term stays'; monthly rates ($875-1,000) are offered too, and tents are limited to one week a month. The seasonal share is not published.
Low-clearance bridge on the GPS route: the operator warns rigs over 10.5 ft tall to use its directions. EKKO is under 10.5 ft (informational).
